caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, floor-length dress with a high collar and a slight train. The main fabric of the dress is a light beige or cream color with a delicate floral pattern consisting of small pink, blue, and green flowers scattered across the surface. The dress is decorated with dark green velvet or satin accents, including a large bow at the center of the collar, green trim along the collar, cuffs, and down the front edges, as well as three prominent bows on the skirt and one on the cuff of the sleeve. There is a row of closely spaced round buttons down the front of the bodice, and the hemline is finished with a ruffled edge in the same floral patterned fabric as the dress. The overall composition centers on the dress, with no background elements or other objects present.
title: Morning Dress
